statement: SpaceXAI committed to deploy NVIDIA Vera CPUs and to expand its Grok AI infrastructure on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform as it scales toward gigawatts of capacity.
why: A named frontier lab standardizing its next build on Nvidia's newest platform is a design win that locks forward accelerator and CPU demand to Nvidia rather than to a rival or in-house part.

impact.mechanism: Choosing Vera CPUs and Vera Rubin systems for orchestration and training converts a gigawatt-scale buildout into committed Nvidia platform purchases and displaces x86 CPU content in the same racks.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA announced that SpaceXAI will deploy NVIDIA Vera CPUs to accelerate its next-generation agentic AI applications.

confidence.basis: Primary vendor announcement on NVIDIA's own newsroom with the customer's president quoted on the record; no unit or dollar figures are claimed.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: NVIDIA Newsroom
